verdict.rationale: AutoGen's first-party docs cover every orchestration pattern the story names: Swarm teams use HandoffMessage for handoffs, AgentTool supports subagent-style orchestration, and crews are served by RoundRobinGroupChat, SelectorGroupChat, GraphFlow and MagenticOneGroupChat. Community users confirm hands-on use of the multi-agent examples; one complaint about output quality concerns results, not whether orchestration works. Missing for 10: in-depth independent hands-on corroboration of the newer Swarm handoff and GraphFlow patterns specifically.

support.subject: As a developer, I can orchestrate multiple agents — handoffs, subagents, or crews — inside one workflow

citations.quote: Swarm: A team that uses HandoffMessage to signal transitions between agents.
You can use `AgentTool` to create a basic multi-agent orchestration setup.
RoundRobinGroupChat is a simple yet effective team configuration where all agents share the same context and take turns responding in a round-robin fashion.
GraphFlow: Multi-agent workflows through a directed graph of agents.
SelectorGroupChat: A team that selects the next speaker using a ChatCompletion model after each message.
